chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muskān, from ʿAnbasah ibn Muṣʿab, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: “A slave-girl of mine committed zina; should I administer the hadd punishment to her?” He said: “Yes.” He said: I said, “May I sell her child?” He said: “Yes.” I said, “May I perform hajj with its price?” He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.أَحُدُّهَا: should I carry out the hadd punishment upon her
key_terms.جَارِيَةٌ: a female slave owned by a master

ai.seo_question: Can the owner administer the hadd punishment to a slave-girl who committed zina and use the sale price of her child for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal exchange with Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning the hadd punishment for a slave-girl who committed zina, the sale of her child, and using that price for hajj. It reflects jurisprudential rulings related to penal law, ownership, and the lawful use of sale proceeds in worship.
